source.title: VDH Laboratories Certified for Drinking Water Analysis PDF (June 11, 2026; green = accept private samples) + DEC Certified Laboratories for Landowner Water Quality Testing + VDH Laboratory drinking-water kits / homeowner path
limitations: Primary private-well / landowner roster: DEC Certified Laboratories for Landowner Water Quality Testing table (retrieved 24 September 2026) — 18 rows including Vermont Department of Health Laboratory.

VDH Laboratories Certified for Drinking Water Analysis PDF dated June 11, 2026 (metadata CreationDate 11 Jun 2026; ModDate 12 Jun 2026; 14 content pages). Note on PDF: Laboratories highlighted in green accept private samples.
Commercial table = 17 DEC landowner labs excluding VDH Laboratory (documented under verified kit path). Out-of-state labs included only because DEC landowner table lists them for Vermont landowners.

Addresses for DEC-listed labs taken from matching VDH certified-PDF rows when name/phone match; Eurofins Portsmouth address unknown (not printed on DEC table; no Portsmouth row under that name on VDH PDF).
Fees intentionally omitted — order form prints kit prices; confirm current fees with VDH Lab / each commercial lab.

Municipal/utility and other VDH-certified labs not on the DEC landowner table omitted from commercial table (e.g., Champlain Water District). City of Rutland Water Laboratory is green on the VDH PDF (accept private samples) but not on the DEC landowner table — linked via PDF only, not tabulated.
Additional-contaminants DEC table (PFAS/Giardia/Radon/Radium) archived in page HTML; not duplicated as a second commercial roster.

verified_paths.name: Vermont Department of Health Laboratory — Drinking Water Testing / Homeowner kits
verified_paths.notes: VDH Drinking Water Testing page for the public. Physical address as printed on kit order form / PDF: 359 South Park Drive, Colchester, VT 05446; mailing PO Box 1125, Burlington, VT 05402-1125; phone 802-338-4724 or 800-660-9997 (toll-free in Vermont); fax 802-338-4706. Homeowner Testing Package recommended on How to Test Your Drinking Water (bacteria annually; inorganic + gross alpha every five years). LAB ID VT 00020 on VDH certified PDF; green = accept private samples. Fees intentionally omitted — confirm with the Lab.

verified_paths.name: VDH Laboratory Forms & Ordering + Sample Drop-off (webstore / order form / Local Health Offices)
verified_paths.notes: Order water and radon test kits via online webstore (https://vdh.webapps.aidcvt.com/water-test) or download drinking water and radon test kit order form; also phone/mail/fax. Sample drop-off: in-person at Lab (Mon–Thu 7:45 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Fri 7:45 a.m.–3:30 p.m.) or Office of Local Health locations / mail-ship within hold times. Schedule note retrieved 24 Sep 2026: state offices will not accept drinking water samples for courier pickup Thu Oct 8, Fri Oct 9, or Mon Oct 12; Lab closed Fri Oct 9 and Mon Oct 12.
